meta.name: Content 1.0 to Content 2.1
meta.notes: Upstream file is named Content 2.0 to Content 2.1. Rows map Content Taxonomy 1.0 codes (OLD RTB ID) to numeric IDs present in Content Taxonomy 2.0 and 2.1. Categories in the NOT MAPPED columns are a separate list and are emitted after the mappings with note "NOT MAPPED (deprecated)".
